verdict.rationale: Docs and community reports confirm Atlas handles Delaware C-corp/LLC incorporation, EIN, founder equity issuance, 83(b) filings, and provides Cooley-drafted legal docs (bylaws, vesting agreements) within days, with independent users confirming a smooth end-to-end filing/checklist experience. Missing for 10: explicit mention of formal 'initial board consent/board approval' documents and independent verification that board resolutions are auto-generated, plus some community reports note extra legwork (state/local filings, franchise tax) still required.
